<!-- pr-reviewer: 2acc51b8e9045d3903c862318fc517106a3d97e8 -->
**Conflicts with current main - not built.** Thanks @austin62jake, the approach reads well; it only needs a merge of main.

**Conflict (one file, trivial):** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`, the `mod` list near line 84.
- This PR adds `mod post_refusal;`
- main added `mod first_setup;` (from fb957ec, "a new document reaches the Setups page...") in the same spot.
- Keep both lines. `state.rs`, `mod.rs` and `shell.rs` auto-merge cleanly, including against the Debug info window and the status-strip changes.

Because the tree does not merge, I did not build or run the suites; please re-run the quick gate (ui lib plus the suites your plan names, and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` from `crates/ui`) after the merge.

**Law check on the diff as read (not built):**
- The refusal reason is kept in full in a scrollable window, with a note when the document changed since. No unwrap/expect/panic in `post_refusal.rs` or the `state.rs` changes. Window state is ephemeral view state, so no command is needed.
- `post_refusal.rs` has a provenance line; the window draws nothing without a refusal, so no snapshot should move.
- PR body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #265`. The decision is in `docs/decisions/265-sticky-post-refusal.md`, not `RECOMMENDED.md`. No CHANGELOG.md edits.
- `state.rs` was already over 400 lines (not blocking).

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge `origin/main` into the branch, resolve `tests/rs` as above, re-gate, push.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a26cf34858fe0cae772e0d9c3640c888566d8558 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks @austin62jake - clean, well-scoped fix.

**What looks good**
- The refusal is kept in `State::post_refusal` and shown in its own `egui::Window` (`post_refusal.rs`, drawn from `shell.rs`). The status line is unchanged.
- The window is cleared on close, on a successful post, and on New/Open (`state.rs`). An edit keeps it and adds the "changed since" note.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/panic in the new code. The window draws nothing without a refusal, so no shell snapshot moves.
- New module has a provenance line. The decision record is in `docs/decisions/`. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #265`, and the PR does not edit `CHANGELOG.md` or `RECOMMENDED.md`.
- The new files stay under 400 lines. `state.rs` is already over, and the PR adds only a few lines to it.

**Local results (merged with current main; the trial merge was clean, no conflicts - GitHub reports MERGEABLE, so the stale `conflicts` label was removed)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 320 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored (includes the 4 `post_refusal` tests)
- `--test shell`: 6 passed. `--test boundary_picks`: 20 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean
- The UI pixel snapshot suites were not run. The window draws nothing without a refusal, so they should not move.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The PR touches no `build.rs`, `.github/`, scripts or dependencies.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
